title: Control commands client
goal: Expose the host's authority actions (kick, mute, unmute, role, transfer host, end, policy) and the receiving side of server-issued control frames as a small typed API with correct local permission checks.
scope_in: Host senders: `control.kick {member, code:'abuse'|'inactive'|'request'|'other'}`, `control.mute {member, until?}`, `control.unmute`, `control.role {member, role:'editor'|'viewer'}`, `control.transfer_host {to}`, `control.end {code:'done'|'abandoned'|'error'}`, `control.policy {auto_approve:'ask'|'trusted'|'everyone', share_history, queue_limit, locked?}`.

Receivers for server-origin frames: `member_joined`, `member_left {code:'left'|'kicked'|'timeout'|'revoked'}`, `roster {version, members}`, `host_changed {host, code:'transfer'|'failover'}`, `session_state {state:'live'|'paused'|'ended'|'expired'}`, `rotate_key {kid, reason}`; each surfaced as a typed event only when `from` is the server.

Local effect tracking: self-muted/self-kicked/self-role-changed state, `locked` flag and `queue_limit` for other lanes' prechecks, effective-from-seq bookkeeping (a control frame applies to frames with higher seq).
Client-side handling of being kicked (close 4403 / `member_left kicked` for self): stop reconnecting, drop keys from memory for that session, emit `removed-from-session`.
Host-failover handling: after `host_changed` naming us, expose `becameHost` so the session engine can start host duties; after losing host, `lostHost`.
Error mapping for denied actions (`forbidden`) so UIs can show why.
scope_out: Key rotation mechanics after kick/rotate_key (generating and granting K[e+1]): lane C057 using C056.
Roster storage: lane C057 owns the cache; this lane reads it.
Queue and approval behaviour changes caused by policy: lanes C058, C061, C075.
Mute/kick UI: TUI/web lanes. REST claim-host: lane C057.
build_against: the mock backend (lane C007): REST from OpenAPI plus the WebSocket relay simulator, started in-process with `startMockBackend()` from @centcom/testkit; no real backend is needed. The relay simulator enforces host-only senders, emits back-to-back `kick`+`rotate_key` with consecutive seq, atomic transfer_host, and failover after a configurable grace (`relay.setHostGrace(120_000)`). Fixtures: contracts/fixtures/events/control.*.json.
interfaces: Host methods: `kick(member: string, code: KickCode)`, `mute(member: string, until?: Date)`, `unmute(member)`, `setRole(member, role: 'editor'|'viewer')`, `transferHost(to: string)`, `endSession(code: EndCode)`, `setPolicy(p: SessionPolicy)`; each returns `Promise<{ seq: number }>` and throws `NotHostError` when `me.role !== 'host'`
`state(): { me: { muted: boolean; mutedUntil?: string; role: Role }; host: string; policy: SessionPolicy; sessionState: 'live'|'paused'|'ended'|'expired'; effectiveFromSeq: number }`
acceptance: `kick(member, 'abuse')` sends one `t:'control'` frame `k:'control.kick'` with `p {member, code}`, no `ct`, a fresh `msg_` id; the simulator's next two frames are `member_left` and `rotate_key` with consecutive seq, and the client emits `member-left` then `rotate-key` in that order.
Non-host `kick` throws NotHostError with zero frames sent; a host `setRole(me, ...)` on itself is rejected locally.

A `control.roster` frame whose `from` is a normal member id (forged) is ignored and counted as a protocol warning; the same frame from the server updates the roster once and a lower `version` than the cached one is ignored.

After `control.mute` for self the model reports `muted: true` and `until`; at the `until` time (fake clock) it flips to false even if no unmute frame arrives; `queue`/`event` sending is disabled locally while muted but presence still sends.

`control.transfer_host {to: me}` followed by `host_changed {host: me, code:'transfer'}` emits `became-host` exactly once and `me.role === 'host'`; the former host receives `lost-host` and `me.role === 'editor'`.
Failover: after the simulator's grace the client sees `host_changed {code:'failover'}` and `session_state` `paused` -> `live` in seq order; no duplicate `became-host`.

Self kicked: after `member_left {member: me, code:'kicked'}` or close 4403 the client does not reconnect, the session key ring for that session is cleared from memory, and `removed-from-session` fires once.

`setPolicy({auto_approve:'trusted', share_history:false, queue_limit:10, locked:true})` validates against the C003 schema (rejects `queue_limit < 0` or an unknown `auto_approve` locally) and the next `policy` event shows the merged state with `locked:true`.
A denied action surfaces `ForbiddenError` from the `sys.error` with `code:'forbidden'` and no state change.
`requestRotation('scheduled')` from the host sends one `control.rotate_request` frame; from a non-host it throws `ForbiddenError` without sending.
tests: control/client.test.ts: every sender against the simulator incl. NotHost and schema rejection.
control/receiver.test.ts: server-only authenticity, version ordering, replay determinism from seq 1.
control/state.test.ts: mute expiry, host change, policy merge, effective-from-seq.
control/removal.test.ts: kicked/revoked flows clear keys and stop reconnecting.
control/fixtures.test.ts: all control.*.json fixtures parse and reduce.
guardrails: MUST ignore the server-only kinds (`member_joined`, `member_left`, `roster`, `host_changed`, `session_state`, `rotate_key`) unless the frame is server-originated (CT-WS-CONTROL); a member-sent copy is a forgery.
MUST NOT change local authority (role, host, mute) from anything but sequenced control frames in `seq` order; MUST NOT trust a ticket or UI claim.
MUST NOT put reasons or names in free text on the wire: only the enum `code` values the schema defines.
Local permission checks are advisory (CT-RBAC rule 4); the server's rejection is final and MUST be shown, not retried.
MUST clear in-memory session keys and stop reconnecting when removed; MUST NOT keep decrypting new frames after a kick.
failure_modes: Control frame rejected because our role changed concurrently -> `ForbiddenError`, state re-synced from the next roster frame.
Missed roster frames (gap) -> C055 replay restores them in order; state is a pure reducer so replay is idempotent.
`control.end` while offline -> kept in the outbox and sent on reconnect; if the session already ended the server error `404`-class is treated as success.
notes: Kick-related key rotation is requested here but performed by lane C057; the interface between them is the `rotate-key` event.
